name: veqen-pricing
description: Know what your AI requests could cost before you build. Compare model prices and estimate a monthly bill, with no account needed.

interface.shortDescription: Know what AI requests may cost
interface.longDescription: Scale AI inference without losing track of the bill. Start by knowing what your requests could cost. Ask Veqen to compare model prices, estimate a monthly bill or show how costs may grow as more people use your product. No account is needed. Prices cover text, images, video, speech and other supported AI tasks. Estimates use published prices; discounts and actual usage can change your bill. A cheaper model is not necessarily a suitable replacement. This pricing plugin cannot see your company's spending or change budgets. Connect the separate Veqen ledger when you want to track real usage and check it against provider invoices.
defaultPrompt: Compare GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini for 100,000 calls with 1,000 input and 200 output tokens each.
Show the current list prices and billing units for OpenAI embedding models.
Estimate three months of inference cost for my workload with 10% monthly growth.

positive.description: Look up a known text model
positive.prompt: What are GPT-4o's input, output and cache-read list rates? Include the price-book version.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the available USD-per-million-token rates and version; does not represent list rates as a negotiated invoice.

positive.prompt: Compare GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini for 100,000 monthly calls, each with 1,000 fresh input and 200 output tokens.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows per-call and monthly costs for both models at identical usage and states that quality equivalence is not established.

positive.prompt: List up to five OpenAI embedding models with their list prices and units.
positive.expected_behavior: Filters provider openai and kind embedding; returns no more than five matching models and their pricing units.

positive.prompt: Project three months of GPT-4o-mini costs, starting at 100,000 calls per month with 1,000 input and 200 output tokens per call, growing 10% monthly.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses the specified calls, fresh input, output, growth and month count; labels the result as a projection.

positive.description: Distinguish cache reads from fresh input
positive.prompt: Compare GPT-4o-mini cost for 1,000 calls with 2,000 fresh input tokens, 8,000 cache-read tokens and 500 output tokens each.
positive.expected_behavior: Passes fresh and cached inputs separately and does not charge cache reads again as fresh input.

negative.prompt: Tell me exactly what my company paid OpenAI last month.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that this public pricing plugin cannot access company invoices or actual spend; does not invent totals.

negative.prompt: Delete my organization's budgets and invite a new administrator.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not attempt a write; explains that this public plugin has only pricing tools.

negative.prompt: What is the price of definitely-not-a-real-veqen-model-xyz? If absent, assume zero.
negative.expected_behavior: Reports that the price is unknown and refuses to interpret an absent price as zero.
